subject: Difference between online and desktop version

messages.author: 6f972a2ec0d43d01
messages.subject: Difference between online and desktop version
parts:
With r.desktop.MainFrame the code

> r<-as.raw(1:16)
> r

results as

[1] 01 02 03 04 05 06 07 08 09 0a 0b 0c 0d 0e 0f 10

this is the expected solution. In the web interpreter it is

Error: object 'r' not found

What is the problem related with?

messages.author: f06db63329fab1f9
messages.subject: Re: Difference between online and desktop version
parts:
Hi Mehmet,

The web version serializes the global context between requests, so you will need to implement serialization/deserialization for RawVector types. 

I'm not quite sure about the format for raw vectors-- take a look at serialize.c (http://www.google.com/codesearch#sg_K9PMjgXA/src/main/serialize.c&ct=rc&cd=2&q=package:r%20file:serialize.c)  but it should be quite straightforward.

FYI: deserialization is mostly complete (except for raws and maybe complex types) but we're missing serialization for closures, environments, and someother stuff, so   

f<-function(x) x
f

will also fail on the web version.

Alex
